lines: <wavy>Mmph...</wavy> let me sleep.
Come back when the sun is up.
I was having a good dream until you arrived.
Unless the village is on fire, this can wait until morning.
The bed had only just warmed up.
My eyes are open, but the rest of me is still asleep.
Please let the night stay quiet.
Did you really need me before breakfast?
Whisper if you must talk. Everyone else is resting.
<wavy>Mmph...</wavy> give me a moment to remember where I am.
I have work at dawn and very little night left.
If this is about trading, my stall opens after sunrise.
The bell did not ring, so I am going back to bed.
You found me sleeping for a reason.
Whatever you need will make more sense in daylight.
I nearly fell out of bed when you spoke.
Can I at least put my boots on before this conversation?
The moon is still high. That is my answer.
I hope this is urgent enough to cost us both some sleep.
Close the door on your way out, please.
I already woke up once for you tonight.
You have bothered me <shake>enough</shake> for one night.
Again? I was sleeping.
The sun is still down, and so should I be.
How many times can one person need me awake?
I went back to bed because our last conversation was over.
This had better be important.
Let me have what remains of the night.
Every interruption makes tomorrow feel longer.
<shake>Enough.</shake> I need sleep.
I locked the door after your last visit. Take the hint.
We settled this before I lay down again.
My pillow has seen less of me than you have tonight.
Wake someone else if this truly cannot wait.
I am not getting dressed a second time.
The rooster has better manners than this.
Do you plan to stand here until dawn?
My patience went back to sleep without me.
One more knock and I may move the bed.
Go away before I forget how polite I was the first time.
<shake>My bed!</shake> What did you do?
That was where I slept. I will remember this.
Why would you break the one thing I needed tonight?
A bed is supposed to make the dark feel safe.
You ruined the only place I had to rest.
Do you understand how cruel that was?
That was not just wood and wool. It was mine.
The whole room feels colder without it.
<shake>Look at it.</shake> You shattered the frame.
Fix this, or do not expect my forgiveness.
I spent weeks saving for that bed.
Where am I supposed to sleep now?
You woke me by tearing my bed apart.
The blankets were a gift from my family.
I cannot replace that before nightfall.
Everyone deserves one safe place to close their eyes.
You broke it while I was right here.
Pick up the pieces and start making this right.
I hope whatever you wanted was worth someone else's comfort.
Stay away from the rest of my home.
That was <shake>mean</shake>. I am telling someone.
Do not talk to me like that.
I am going to find a grown-up.
You should not say things that hurt people.
That made my stomach feel funny.
I do not want to stand near you anymore.
You sound like someone who causes trouble.
I thought grown-ups were supposed to know better.
That was not a joke. It was nasty.
<shake>Leave me alone.</shake>
My mother said I can walk away when someone is cruel.
I am not playing with you after that.
Why would you say that to a kid?
I know people who will believe me.
You made me want to cry, but I will not do it here.
I am going where the iron golem can see us.
You do not get to scare me for fun.
I was being nice to you.
Someone needs to teach you better words.
I want my family now.
My liege... how could you?
I lowered my weapon because I still remember who you are.
I will not strike our ruler. Please do not force me to reconsider.
You carry the crown, but that blow still hurt.
Anyone else would face my anger. From you, I need an explanation.
The village trusted you to protect us.
I do not know whether to bow or run from you.
My liege, please step back before someone else gets hurt.
You hold our trust. Do not turn it into a weapon.
I am standing down, but I will not forget this.
Was my service worth so little to you?
Tell me this was an accident.
I followed your orders because I believed they kept us safe.
The others will ask why I did not defend myself.
A crown cannot make pain feel honorable.
I still bow to you, even while my hands are shaking.
Please remember that your people are not your enemies.
I would rather walk away than raise steel against my liege.
This village needs a ruler it does not fear.
Give me one reason to keep faith after today.
You are easy to talk to.
It is good to meet someone who <pulse>listens</pulse>.
I did not expect to enjoy this conversation so much.
You make a quiet afternoon feel shorter.
I would be glad to share a table with you again.
You remembered what I said earlier. That matters.
Most travelers hurry off before hearing the answer.
I was in a poor mood before you stopped by.
You ask thoughtful questions.
This was a <pulse>pleasant</pulse> surprise.
I can see why people speak well of you.
Thank you for giving me room to finish my story.
You have a way of putting nervous people at ease.
I hope your next visit is not too far away.
It is rare to laugh with someone I just met.
You made me feel like my work was worth asking about.
I trust you a little more than I did this morning.
The village could use more conversations like this one.
I am glad you chose to spend some time here.
I will remember this talk fondly.
I should have known better than to speak with you.
<pulse>Careful.</pulse> Villages remember cruelty.
This conversation was a mistake.
You make every bit of patience feel wasted.
I am done listening to your excuses.
Every word from you makes me want you gone.
People warn each other about behavior like yours.
I should have kept my door shut.
You proved my worst suspicion right.
<shake>Enough.</shake> I am angry, and you know why.
Do not follow me when I walk away.
You came here looking for a reaction. You have one.
I will not let you spoil the rest of my day.
Find someone else willing to put up with that tone.
I tried to be civil, but you treated kindness like weakness.
Another word may bring the guard into this.
You owe me an apology, not another argument.
I have nothing left to offer this conversation.
Leave before anger makes this uglier.
Next time, I will remember not to welcome you.
You have asked enough questions for one day.
I have work to do. Find someone else to ask.
We already covered that.
My answers are getting shorter with every question.
Give me a moment to think in peace.
You are turning curiosity into a chore.
Come back later if it still matters.
I have told you everything I know.
Asking again will not change the answer.
Enough. My patience is <pulse>running low</pulse>.
Are you listening to any of my replies?
I cannot explain it better than I already did.
Try finding the answer yourself this time.
You keep asking before I finish speaking.
That question has worn out its welcome.
I am beginning to feel like an information board.
Pick one last thing you truly need to know.
There are other people in this village with stories.
I need my thoughts for the work in front of me.
Let the subject rest before we both lose our patience.
Enough of that subject for now.
Try saying something we have not discussed.
We have already had this conversation.
That story does not improve with repetition.
Let the matter rest for a while.
I would rather listen to the wind than circle this again.
We are walking over the same ground.
Change the subject or enjoy the silence.
I am running out of patience with the repetition.
Enough. This talk is going <wavy>around in circles</wavy>.
I remember what you said the first time.
There is nothing new left for either of us to add.
Please stop dragging us back to that point.
I came to chat, not repeat myself.
The topic is closed.
Say something new before the bell rings again.
We could both be doing better things by now.
I am starting to know your next sentence before you say it.
Another telling will not make me agree.
Come back when you have something different on your mind.
Hmph. Maybe do not quit your day job.
I have heard funnier sounds from a door hinge.
That joke needed more <jump>work</jump>.
It almost became funny.
The punchline tripped before it reached us.
I admire the courage, if not the joke.
You aimed for laughter and hit the floor.
Let that one rest before trying another.
The funny part must have taken a different road.
That was awful, but at least you committed to it.
I laughed once, but only because you looked so hopeful.
Was there more to it?
The silence afterward was the best part.
I think the chicken joke was kinder to you.
Warn me next time so I can practice smiling.
That one needs to go back in the oven.
You lost me somewhere before the punchline.
I would explain why it failed, but we both need to move on.
Even the children would ask for their turn back.
Keep trying. The next one has nowhere to go but up.
